title: Privacy Policy
md:
**Last updated:** November 2026

This policy is from Rekha Krishnamurthy / Makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy ("**we**", "**us**", "**our**"). We run the website https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/ (the "**Site**"). We offer makeup services (bridal, party, editorial and fashion), makeup courses and personal shopping (together, the "**Services**"). This policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal data when you visit the Site, send a request or book with us.

By using the Site or sending your details through our forms, you agree to this policy.

### 1.1 Information We Collect
When you fill in a request or contact form, book a consult or join a course, we may collect:
- **Contact details:** your name, email, phone number, city and country.
- **Booking details:** the service you want (for example bridal, engagement, party, editorial, fashion or a course), your dates, your venue and any notes you share.
- **Messages:** what you send us by WhatsApp, phone, email, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest or any other channel listed on the Site.
- **Payment details:** if you pay an advance, we (or our payment partner) may handle the payment details. We do not keep full card or bank details on our own servers.
- **Technical data:** your IP address, browser, device and the pages you visit. Cookies and tools such as Google Tag Manager also collect this on their own.

We do not try to collect sensitive data, such as health details. The only exception is what you choose to tell us, for example a skin allergy that affects which products we use.

### 1.2 How We Use Your Information
We use your details to:
- Reply to your request and confirm bookings for makeup, courses or personal shopping.
- Contact you about your booking, timing, changes and payments.
- Improve the Site, our Services and your experience.
- Send news, offers or course updates, unless you have opted out.
- Meet legal, tax and accounting rules.

We do **not** sell or rent your personal data to anyone.

### 1.3 Sharing of Information
In some cases, your details may go to:
- **Service providers** who help us run the Site, take payments, send messages or manage bookings. Examples are hosting firms, payment gateways and email, SMS or WhatsApp providers. They must keep your data private.
- **Team members and helpers** who work on your booking, such as an assisting makeup artist or hairstylist.
- **Legal authorities**, when the law or a court requires it, or to protect our rights, safety or property.

Without your consent, we do not give your data to others for their own marketing.

### 1.4 Cookies & Tracking
The Site may use cookies and similar tools, including Google Tag Manager and other analytics tools. They show us how people use the Site, so we can make it work better. You can turn cookies off in your browser settings. However, some parts of the Site may not work as intended if you do.

### 1.5 Data Retention
We keep your personal data only as long as we need it for the reasons in this policy. That includes keeping booking records, meeting legal and tax rules and settling disputes. After that, we delete it safely or make it anonymous.

### 1.6 Data Security
We take reasonable steps to keep your data safe from misuse, change, leaks or loss. Still, no way of sending data over the internet is 100% secure, so we cannot promise complete security.

### 1.7 Your Rights
Subject to the law, you can ask us to:
- Show you the personal data we hold about you.
- Correct data that is wrong or incomplete.
- Delete your data, unless the law requires us to keep it.
- Stop sending you marketing at any time. For example, reply "unsubscribe" or contact us directly.

To use these rights, email **contact@rekhakrishnamurthy.com** or call **+91-98454 80507**.

### 1.8 Children's Privacy
Our Services are for people aged 18 or over. A minor can use them only with a parent or guardian involved, for example for party makeup at a minor's event. We do not knowingly collect a child's personal data without that involvement.

### 1.9 Third-Party Links
The Site may link to other platforms, such as Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, Pinterest, YouTube, WhatsApp and Google Maps or Reviews. However, those sites have their own privacy rules, and we are not responsible for them. So please read their privacy policies.

### 1.10 Changes to This Policy
This policy may change from time to time. When it does, the new version will appear on this page with a new "Last updated" date. If you keep using the Site after a change, you accept the new policy.

### 1.11 Contact Us
For questions about this policy or your personal data, contact:
**Makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy**
📞 +91-98454 80507
✉️ contact@rekhakrishnamurthy.com

title: Terms & Conditions
md:
**Last updated:** November 2026

Welcome to https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/ (the "**Site**"). Rekha Krishnamurthy / Makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy ("**we**", "**us**", "**our**") owns and runs it. These Terms & Conditions ("**Terms**") cover your use of the Site. They also cover any request, booking or purchase of our Services: Bridal, Engagement, Non-Bridal, Party, Editorial and Fashion Makeup, Makeup Courses and Personal Shopping.

By using the Site or booking our Services, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Site or our Services.

### 2.1 About Our Services
We offer expert makeup in HD and Airbrush, as well as makeup courses and personal shopping. Our makeup services cover:

- **Bridal Makeup**, for pre-wedding, sangeet and wedding-day looks. It usually starts with a consult about your ideas, skin, outfit, jewellery, venue and timing. On the day, we work with you on site.
- **Engagement Makeup**, for engagement functions and related pre-wedding events.
- **Non-Bridal Makeup**, for the bridal party and family, such as bridesmaids and relatives, at wedding events.
- **Party Makeup**, for birthdays, anniversaries and other social events.
- **Editorial Makeup**, for magazine, shoot and portfolio looks.
- **Fashion Makeup**, for runway shows and creative looks.

We use premium products from known brands, such as MAC Cosmetics, Bobbi Brown, Estée Lauder, HUDA Beauty, Lancôme, Urban Decay and Anastasia Beverly Hills, among others. We also follow standard hygiene steps, including cleaning tools, brushes and accessories before use.

We share open dates, exact packages and prices directly when you ask. They may vary with the service, venue, date, event and your needs. They may also change without notice.

### 2.2 Enquiries & Bookings
- Sending a form on the Site, or contacting us by phone, WhatsApp, email or social media, does **not** confirm a booking on its own.
- Your booking is confirmed only after (a) we both agree the service, date, venue and price, and (b) we receive any advance that applies.
- You must give correct details when you ask or book. That includes your name, contact details, event date, venue and anything we should know, such as skin allergies.
- We may decline or cancel a booking at our discretion. For example, this may happen if a date is double-booked, if we are not free, or if we cannot serve your venue.

### 2.3 Pricing & Payment
- We quote prices case by case. They depend on the service, the number of people, the venue, travel and the date.
- You may need to pay an advance to confirm a booking. Then the balance is usually due on or before the service date, as agreed at booking.
- All payments are in Indian Rupees (INR), unless we agree otherwise.
- Prices may change. However, once we confirm a booking at an agreed price, that price stays the same unless the scope changes. Examples are more people, extra looks or a new venue or date.

### 2.4 Client Responsibilities
- Please be ready at the agreed time and place. If you cause a delay, it may affect the quality or completeness of the service, and Makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy is not responsible for that.
- Please tell us in advance about any skin allergies, sensitivities or medical conditions that matter for makeup.
- We are not liable for reactions to products if they come from allergies or sensitivities you did not tell us about.

### 2.5 Makeup Courses & Training
- We share course dates, fees, topics and any certificate details separately when you enrol.
- Your seat is confirmed only once you pay the course fee.
- Course materials, methods and content are for the enrolled student's own learning. You may not copy, record, resell or share them without our written consent.

### 2.6 Intellectual Property
- All content on the Site, including text, images, portfolio photos, logos and videos, belongs to Rekha Krishnamurthy / Makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy or is used with permission. The law protects it as intellectual property.
- You may not copy, share or use any Site content for business purposes without our written consent.
- We may use photos or videos taken during a booking, such as bridal shoots or events, in our portfolio, marketing and promotion, including on the Site and social media. If you do not want this, tell us in writing when you book.

### 2.7 Limitation of Liability
As far as the law allows:
- Our team always gives its best expert effort. However, we cannot promise a set result, because skin type, lighting, photos and personal taste all affect the outcome.
- Also, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental or follow-on loss or damage from using our Services or the Site.
- Our total liability for any claim about a booking will not be more than the amount you paid for that booking.

### 2.8 Third-Party Links & Social Media
The Site links to other platforms, such as Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, Pinterest, YouTube, WhatsApp and Google. We are not responsible for their content, policies or practices.

### 2.9 Governing Law & Jurisdiction
The laws of India govern these Terms. Only the courts of Bangalore, Karnataka, India can hear any dispute about these Terms or our Services.

### 2.10 Changes to These Terms
These Terms may change from time to time. When they do, the new version will appear on this page with a new "Last updated" date. If you keep using the Site or our Services after a change, you accept the new Terms.

title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
md:
**Last updated:** November 2026

This Refund & Cancellation Policy covers bookings with Makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy. It applies to makeup (Bridal, Engagement, Non-Bridal, Party, Editorial and Fashion), Makeup Courses and Personal Shopping. It also applies whether you book through https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/ or directly by phone, WhatsApp, email or social media.

### 3.1 Booking Confirmation & Advance Payment
- Your booking is confirmed only once we receive the advance we told you about when you asked.
- Then the advance holds your date and time slot for you alone, because we do not double-book.

### 3.2 Cancellations by the Client
- **You must cancel in writing**, by email, WhatsApp or a message on the Site. So the cancellation counts from the date and time we receive it.
- **30 days or more before the service date:** we do not refund the advance. However, you can move it to a future date, if that date is free.
- **Less than 30 days before the service date:** we do not refund the advance, because we cannot offer the slot to another client at short notice.
- **No-show or cancelling on the event day:** we give no refund, and you may still owe any balance.
- **Makeup courses:** if you cancel 30 days before the course starts, you may get a partial refund, minus an admin fee. After the course starts, fees are usually non-refundable, unless we decide otherwise.

### 3.3 Cancellations or Changes by Us
- Rarely, we may need to cancel or move a confirmed booking for reasons outside our control, such as illness, an emergency or force majeure. In that case, we will tell you as soon as we can. Then you can choose either (a) a full refund of what you paid, or (b) a new date that suits us both.
- Also, with your consent, we will try to arrange a qualified artist from our team to step in, where we can.

### 3.4 Rescheduling
- To reschedule, ask at least **30 days** ahead. However, the new date depends on whether we are free.
- You can usually reschedule **once** for free. After that, changes may cost extra.

### 3.5 Refund Process
- First, we approve the refund. Then we pay it back to the way you paid, within **7–14 business days** of approval.
- However, bank and payment times may vary, and we cannot control them.

### 3.6 Service-Related Issues
- If you are unhappy with a service, please tell us within **24–48 hours** of the event. Then we can review it and, where fair, offer a fix. That may be a partial adjustment, a credit for a future service or another remedy, at our discretion. A refund is not automatic when a finished, expert service simply did not match personal taste.

### 3.7 Non-Refundable Items
- Some costs are usually non-refundable once spent. These are travel charges, trial fees (if paid separately and the trial has taken place) and money paid to others for you. For example, that includes products bought for your event through Personal Shopping.

### 3.8 Contact for Cancellations/Refunds
To cancel, reschedule or ask about a refund, contact us at:
📞 +91-98454 80507
✉️ contact@rekhakrishnamurthy.com

title: Disclaimer
md:
**Last updated:** November 2026

Rekha Krishnamurthy / Makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy ("**we**", "**us**", "**our**") shares the content on https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/ (the "**Site**") as general information only. By using the Site or our Services, you accept the points below.

### 4.1 No Professional/Medical Advice
Our makeup, courses and any tips on the Site or in a consult are about looks only. They are not skin, medical or health advice. If you have a skin condition, allergy or sensitivity, please see a qualified doctor before any makeup. Also, tell us about it in advance.

### 4.2 Results May Vary
Makeup results depend on many things, such as your skin type, tone and texture, the light and the photos or video. We always aim for the best result our skill allows. Still, we cannot promise that your result will match a sample photo, a portfolio image or anything shown on the Site or social media.

### 4.3 Testimonials
Reviews on the Site, including those from Google Reviews, share the views of single clients. Each person's result may differ, so we cannot promise the same for every client.

### 4.4 Portfolio & Images
Photos in our portfolio show past work. They are examples only. So your own result may differ, based on your face, your wishes and the details of your booking.

### 4.5 Third-Party Content & Links
The Site may link to other websites and social platforms, such as Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, Pinterest, YouTube, WhatsApp and Google Maps. We do not control them, so we are not responsible for what they say or do.

### 4.6 Allergies & Product Sensitivities
We use premium, pro-grade products in good faith. Brands include MAC Cosmetics, Bobbi Brown, Estée Lauder, HUDA Beauty, Lancôme, Urban Decay and Anastasia Beverly Hills, among others. We also follow reasonable hygiene steps, such as cleaning tools and accessories before use. Even so, people can react to a product, whatever its quality or brand. So we are not liable for skin reactions caused by the products, above all when you did not tell us about the problem before the service.

### 4.7 Accuracy of Information
We try to keep the Site's details, such as services, guide prices and course facts, right and up to date. However, we cannot promise that all of it is full, current or free of errors at all times. So please check the details with us before you confirm a booking.

### 4.8 Limitation of Liability
As far as the law allows, Rekha Krishnamurthy / Makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental or follow-on damages from using, or not being able to use, the Site or our Services.
